note: Holidays used to estimate expiry dates. Exact expiry dates are not typed in by hand any more: expiry_sync.py downloads them from Upstox's public instrument files and writes expiry_synced.json. NSE 2026 holidays match NSE circular NSE/FAOP/71777 plus the 15 Jan 2026 F&O holiday. 26 Jan 2027 (Republic Day) is fixed; the rest of the 2027 holidays are not published yet.
